test_markdown_code_blocks: test runnable code blocks collected from markdown files using the pytest plugin
parse_decorators_from_code: parse pytest-decorator comments from code strings and return cleaned code with decorator callables
import_decorator_from_path: import a decorator function from a dotted module path like package.module.name
collect_markdown_file: collect markdown files as pytest items with runnable code blocks for testing
run_markdown_code_with_decorators: run extracted code blocks from markdown with applied pytest decorators in an isolated namespace
